description: Call this when the user asks about today's or a given date's liturgical day: the feast or saint, the Mass reading citations, whether it is a day of fasting or abstinence, the season or liturgical color, or the Rosary mysteries for that date. Covers November 9, 2026 to December 31, 2027, following the General Roman Calendar for the United States. Returns the celebration, rank, season and color, fast and abstinence, the reading citations with a link to the readings on the USCCB site, the saints, the quote of the day with its source, the Rosary mysteries with links to the free guided Rosary, the Exodus 90 day number from January 11 to April 10, 2027, and links to the day's page, month calendar and calendar feed. With no arguments it uses today's date in US Eastern time (America/New_York), because this server cannot see the user's time zone; pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the user's own date. Set include_text to true to add the Douay-Rheims (Challoner) text of the passages, which differs from the translation read at Mass; some readings are citations only. Desert Road Catholic is independent and not affiliated with the USCCB or Exodus 90. Example: "What are today's Mass readings?" or get_daily with {"date": "2027-02-10", "include_text": true}.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, from 2026-11-09 to 2027-12-31. Leave out for today in US Eastern time.

include_text.description: Add the Douay-Rheims (Challoner) text of the readings that have it. Default false (citations only).

name: get_daily

abstinence_day.description: A day of abstinence from meat.

celebration.description: The day's celebration: id, name, rank, rank_label, season, season_label, colors, color_label, holy_day_of_obligation.

citation_only.description: Readings with no Douay-Rheims text on the site.

date_basis.description: Where the date came from: the caller, or today in US Eastern time when no date was given.

time_zone.description: America/New_York, when the date is today in US Eastern time.

douay_rheims.description: Only with include_text: translation, edition, credit, source_url, a note that this differs from the text read at Mass, and the readings given as citations only.

exodus90.description: Present from January 11 to April 10, 2027: day, label (Day N of the ninety) and the day's page URL.

exodus90_day.description: Which of the ninety days, from January 11 to April 10, 2027; otherwise null.

fast_day.description: A day of fasting and abstinence.

markers.description: Short markers: fast, abst, oblig, sol.

notes.description: Lectionary, USCCB, calendar and independence notes.

obligation_note.description: Present on a holy day of obligation in the United States.

penance.description: Fast or abstinence for the day: kind (fast_and_abstinence, abstinence or abstinence_lifted) and text. Null on most days.

quote.description: The quote of the day: text, author, work, reference, translator, source and url.

readings.description: Mass reading citations: first_reading, psalm, second_reading (Sundays and solemnities), gospel.

readings_douay_rheims.description: Only with include_text: for each reading that has it, the Douay-Rheims (Challoner) passage with reference and verses.

rosary.description: The Rosary mysteries for the day, with the set page and the guided Rosary links.

saints.description: Saints and blessed on the calendar that day, with a short fact when known.

usccb_url.description: The readings on the USCCB site: the dated page for today and past dates, the general daily readings page for future dates.
